reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering wild forage, relationship and artisan items, winter forage and seeds, wood products and flooring, fish, and wool were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary and fish names, relationship semantics, dynamic wine naming, tree and fence behavior, seasonal seed terminology, object gender, and flooring instructions; both found no remaining objective issue.
